title: 核实基础备份和来源链
premise: 隔离边界明确，接班方核对基础备份标识与文件校验。
listeningTask: 辨别备份创建时间、完成时间和恢复目标。

lines.en: The base backup started at midnight. It completed at twenty past, UTC.
lines.zh: 基础备份午夜开始，UTC零点二十分完成。

lines.en: Which backup identifier did you restore? Filenames alone aren't enough provenance evidence.
lines.zh: 恢复的是哪个备份标识？只看文件名不足以证明来源。

lines.en: Drill backup B seventeen, recorded here. Its backup manifest matches verified file checksums.
lines.zh: 演练备份B17，记录在这里，备份清单和已核验文件校验和一致。

lines.en: Just to confirm, drill source only, right? Not a convenient untracked production copy.
lines.zh: 确认一下，只用演练数据源，对吧？不是随手拿的未追踪生产副本。

lines.en: Yes, the dataset approval is attached. Were encryption and restore access tested?
lines.zh: 是，数据集批准记录已附，加密和恢复权限测试了吗？

lines.en: They were, through the approved key service. We recorded outcomes, not secret values.
lines.zh: 测了，通过批准的密钥服务，记录结果而非密钥值。

lines.en: Let me tail the log next. I want the backup identity during startup.
lines.zh: 接下来我盯日志，看启动时确认的备份标识。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for that link. Maybe the storage view needs refreshing.
lines.zh: 好，我提供链接，存储视图可能需要刷新。

lines.en: The startup record matches B seventeen. That removes one source mismatch concern.
lines.zh: 启动记录匹配B17，排除了一个来源不匹配疑点。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis has verified provenance. Next separate backup time from target.
lines.zh: 那当前假设有已验证来源，下一步区分备份时间和恢复目标。
